checks.inputs: Pinned original gemm.cu, prefill.cpp and gemm.hpp; pinned standalone object hashes; exported flags, recipes and link command verified exactly before compilation. Archive members must be unique and match standalone objects.
checks.compile: Exact HIP/CXX defines/includes/optimization/architecture/language flags and /src/build-906 working directory. Only object/dependency output destinations change; original -MT dependency target preserved. Both rebuilt objects must match exact hashes before relink.
checks.link: Fresh relink uses unchanged original generate object, original archives and original dynamic/static library arguments in exact order. Only executable output destination changes. Result must equal c18316d678a669c309cb95e2f5de9af03fa5573256fd0e093aafc4b41000d049. All link input hashes captured before/after.
checks.isolation: Pinned locally available image with pull disabled, no network or exposed GPU devices, read-only root filesystem and source/package mounts, only fresh /out and tmpfs writable, dropped capabilities and no-new-privileges. No resulting executable or observer code is run.
checks.bounds: Each compiler max300 seconds, link180, bounded tool probes; child process groups killed on timeout. Outer container timeout1000 seconds, owned-container-only cleanup20 seconds and launcher wait10 seconds. CPU4, memory12GiB, pids512, tmpfs2GiB.
checks.fail_closed: Any source/object/recipe/flag/archive/rebuilt-object/relinked-binary mismatch stops. Does not relax equality or continue to observer build. stdout/stderr/returncodes/commands/output hashes retained for steps; initial host receipt exists before source validation. Cleanup errors force FAILED status and passed=false.
checks.integrity: Original metadata/inputs checked after run; source/build remains read-only inside container. Output path freshness and exclusion from source/package checked before creation.

scope: Review and seven CPU unit tests only; no actual ROCm build, link, container, MI50 or GPU work by reviewer.
interpretation: Successful execution would bind these rebuilt original gemm/prefill objects to their original archive members and reproduce the frozen c183 binary from original link inputs. It does not itself establish observer device-code parity or authorize model execution.
remaining_gates: Root executes this exact reviewed script and independently checks terminal receipts.
On mismatch preserve artifacts and analyze; do not normalize away differences.
Only after PASS proceed to separately reviewed observer build/device parity and authorized counts-only run.
